facts.value: Initializes Donkey Kong's aerial SpecialS: divides self_vel.x by SpecialS.x3C_MIN_STICK_X_MOMENTUM without validation, overwrites self_vel.y with zero, selects ftDk_MS_SpecialAirS with flags 0/start 0/rate 1/blend 0/NULL, calls ftAnim_8006EBA4, clears cmd_vars[0], and arms ftDk_SpecialLw_8010E148 in accessory4_cb. Division is not necessarily attenuation and does not test stick input.

facts.rationale: Supersedes the baseline purpose with actual callee effects and avoids assuming all tuning values imply damping or finite bounded results.
facts.value: Runs aerial SpecialS physics by conditionally updating vertical self-velocity when cmd_vars[0] is nonzero and unconditionally preparing a horizontal animation-velocity contribution. The fall helper subtracts SpecialS.x44_AERIAL_GRAVITY and clamps results strictly below minus the common terminal velocity. The friction helper receives SpecialS.x40_MOMENTUM_TRANSITION_MODIFIER and writes x74_anim_vel.x, not self_vel.x. The callback neither changes motion state nor writes cmd_vars[0]; its trailing repeated test has an empty body.

facts.rationale: Supersedes the baseline's unconditional normal-ground completion and interpreted contact predicates with exact dispatch conditions and verified frame-carrying helper behavior.
facts.value: Maintains paired SpecialS and SpecialAirS callbacks. A false frame-remaining predicate dispatches grounded completion through ft_8008A2BC and aerial completion through ftCo_Fall_Enter; grounded completion normally reaches Wait but common exceptional branches can intervene. Both IASA bodies are empty. Grounded collision selects ft_800827A0 for nonzero cmd_vars[0] and ft_80082708 for zero, converting to SpecialAirS on a false result. Aerial collision converts to SpecialS on a nonzero ft_80081D0C result. Both conversions carry cur_anim_frame into the destination at rate 1 using coll_mf and restore effect hitlag callbacks only when x2219_b0 is true; they do not call the local entry routines.
